_doc: GENE run paths behind update_results.py, one entry per discharge and x0 (rho_tor, as in the x0_<x0> folder name).
diag_root:  GENE output root; corners are read from <diag_root>/x0_<x0>/<tag>/scanfilesNNNN (plot_corners --diag-root).
ped_root:   ped_grid cheaseBS cases <tag>/ on scratch (profiles.iterdb, geqdsk) (plot_corners --ped-root).

extra_roots: more GENE roots whose x0_<x0>/<tag>/scanfilesNNNN merge by ky with the corners (optional). <diag_root>_ky* siblings (e.g. corners_kyhi, corners_kylo from corner_gene_scan --diag-root) are always read; _nz/_res2/_test siblings never.
res2_roots: extra dirs searched for 2x-resolution runs, beside <diag_root> and its _res2 siblings.
nz_compare: nz0 of the comparison runs (corners_nz<N>.png), or null; nz_root: their root, null for <diag_root>_nz<N>.
field_omega: fit every ky's field trace and append it to its omega file (field_omega.py --write) before plotting.
nz_subdir: when nz_compare is set, also run the field fits and every plot on the nz0 = N runs, into x0_<x0>/nz<N>/.
outliers: corners_outlier.png, TPED's outlier analysis per corner and ky (grid-scale oscillation, gamma < 0, D/chi_e, chi_i/chi_e, x0).
Any option key (field_omega, modes, mode_extent, outliers, field_fits, spread, max_params) set in an entry overrides 'defaults'; a CLI flag overrides both.
enabled: false keeps an entry listed but skipped unless named with --shot and --x0.

cases: {NAME: x0} named case dirs to plot instead of the ped_grid corners (plot_corners --case): GENE under <diag_root>/x0_<x0>/<NAME>/, profiles under <ped_root>/<NAME>/; x0 null for the entry's own. ref_case: the one drawn as reference. scan_name: title text.
A discharge key '<shot>_<name>' (e.g. 132543_nstxu_test) is its own results folder and summary group (update_results --group); its shot is the part before the first '_'.
